missions.name: Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicle
missions.lesson: The lunar rover expanded how far Apollo astronauts could travel and conduct field science beyond the landing site.
missions.quizPrompt: Why did the Apollo astronauts use a lunar rover?
quizOptions: To travel from Earth to the Moon

missions.name: Sojourner
missions.lesson: Sojourner was the first rover to operate on Mars and helped pioneer robotic surface exploration.
quizOptions: It was the first rover to operate on Mars
It was the first person on Mars

missions.name: Opportunity
missions.lesson: Opportunity was planned for about 90 Martian days but continued exploring for nearly fifteen years, uncovering evidence of ancient water.
missions.quizPrompt: How long did Opportunity ultimately explore Mars?
